an11.13:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme
an11.13:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ vassāvāsaṃ upagantukāmo hoti.
an11.13:2.5: tattha kammantañceva adhiṭṭhahissāmi bhagavantañca lacchāmi kālena kālaṃ dassanāyāti.
an11.13:3.2: nandiyopi kho sakko sāvatthiyaṃ vassāvāsaṃ upagacchi
an11.13:3.3: tattha kammantañceva adhiṭṭhāya bhagavantañca lacchati kālena kālaṃ dassanāya.
an11.13:3.4: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
an11.13:4.2: sambahulā kira bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
an11.13:4.4: athakho nandiyo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho nandiyo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an11.13:4.6: sambahulā kira bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
an11.13:4.8: tesaṃ no bhante nānāvihārehi viharataṃ kena vihārena vihātabbanti.
an11.13:5.2: etaṃ kho nandiya tumhākaṃ paṭirūpaṃ kulaputtānaṃ yaṃ tumhe tathāgataṃ upasaṅkamitvā puccheyyātha
an11.13:5.3: tesaṃ no bhante nānāvihārehi viharitaṃ kena vihārena vihātabbanti
an11.13:5.4: saddho kho nandiya ārādhako hoti no asaddho
an11.13:5.10: imesu kho te nandiya chasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya pañcasu dhammesu ajjhattaṃ sati upaṭṭhapetabbā
an11.13:6.2: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti
an11.13:6.3: iti kho te nandiya tathāgataṃ ārabbha ajjhattaṃ sati upaṭṭhapetabbā.
an11.13:7.2: svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti
an11.13:7.3: iti kho te nandiya dhammaṃ ārabbha ajjhattaṃ sati upaṭṭhapetabbā.
an11.13:8.2: lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me
an11.13:8.3: yassa kalyāṇamittā anukampakā atthakāmā ovādakā anusāsitāti
an11.13:8.4: iti kho te nandiya kalyāṇamitte ārabbha ajjhattaṃ sati upaṭṭhapetabbā.
an11.13:9.1: puna caparaṃ tvaṃ nandiya attano cāgaṃ anussareyyāsi
an11.13:9.2: lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me
an11.13:9.3: yohaṃ maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitāya pajāya vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasāmi muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgaratoti
an11.13:9.4: iti kho te nandiya cāgaṃ ārabbha ajjhattaṃ sati upaṭṭhapetabbā.
an11.13:10.1: puna caparaṃ tvaṃ nandiya devatā anussareyyāsi
an11.13:10.2: yā tā devatā atikkammeva kabaḷīkārabhakkhānaṃ devatānaṃ sahabyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapannā tā karaṇīyaṃ attano na samanupassanti katassa vā paṭiccayaṃ
an11.13:10.3: seyyathāpi nandiya bhikkhu asamayavimutto akaraṇīyaṃ attano na samanupassati katassa vā paṭiccayaṃ
an11.13:10.4: evameva kho nandiya yā tā devatā atikkammeva kabaḷīkārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapannā tā karaṇīyaṃ attano na samanupassanti katassa vā paṭiccayanti
an11.13:10.5: iti kho te nandiya devatā ārabbha ajjhattaṃ sati upaṭṭhapetabbā
an11.13:11.1: imehi kho nandiya ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako pajahateva pāpake akusale dhamme na upādiyati
an11.13:11.2: seyyathāpi nandiya kumbho nikkujjo no vantaṃ paccāmasati
an11.13:11.3: seyyathāpi nandiya tiṇā aggi mutto ḍahaññeva gacchati no daḍḍhaṃ paccudāvattati
an11.13:11.4: evameva kho nandiya imehi ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako pajahateva pāpake akusale dhamme na upādiyatīti. 14
